lines.text: Drill complete. Four minutes ten. Two stragglers. A good bore.
You told the guild the Span was fine. It is fine. Today.
You stood on the weakest span. I watched. It did not move. Do not do that again.
I carry a whistle. It is the clapper from the Red Span's rope-bell. I have not blown it in nine years.

choice.text: Blow it for the drill. I will stand with you.
Keep it. You do not owe the Span a sound.

lines.text: ...Thank you. I will blow it when I am ready.
